policy.principle: Third-party runtimes remain execution surfaces; MindCore owns policy, routing, audit and promotion.
policy.security: Credentials, browser sessions, filesystem roots and process execution stay behind explicit execution domains.

tools.integration: Graft graph/context operations are exposed through the MindCore capability contract.
OpenMontage is attached as a supervised production workspace; planning, research, scripting, rendering and validation remain auditable task operations.
Local MCP code intelligence is exposed through typed structural-query operations; repository indexing is gated.
Supervised browser automation capability with isolated browser sessions and explicit action approval.

Persistent AgentMemory operations use the deployed Cognee memory service. Writes and recalls are session-scoped and return request provenance; unsupported lifecycle/delete operations are intentionally not advertised.
Agent Skills-compatible scientific workflows are discoverable and executable through a supervised research workspace.
Editorial HTML/SVG diagram generation and redraws become evidence-linked visualization artifacts.
Structured security skills are available to authorized defensive and security-research workflows behind the admin approval gate.
tools.security: authorized systems only; no unrestricted credentials or autonomous production changes

tools.integration: Harness patterns are indexed as a reference layer for evaluating orchestration, context, tool design, constraints and safe autonomy.
Context is exposed through an inspectable filesystem-oriented interface for knowledge, memory and skills.
Query OpenStreetMap through Overpass; results become provenance-linked geospatial evidence and Point Registry candidates.
Geographic hints and visual geolocation support routed through the shared Point Registry and evidence contract.
Street View metadata and permitted imagery workflows become evidence-linked geospatial observations.
tools.cost_model: requires-billing-enabled-project; image requests billed per use; metadata requests currently listed as uncharged; Mapillary is the default free imagery alternative

tools.integration: Free alternative to paid Street View imagery. Search street-level imagery by bounding box and retrieve image metadata; access token requires a free account/application registration.
tools.security: read-only imagery metadata; obey Mapillary API terms and attribution

tools.integration: Authorized internet-exposure research with explicit scope, rate controls, credentials and audit trail.
tools.cost_model: free-account key exists but search/DNS credits and paid plans can be required; keep disabled until quota/cost scope is confirmed

tools.integration: Free, keyless passive subdomain discovery from public certificate-transparency records plus DNS-over-HTTPS resolution; scope restricted to the requested domain.
tools.security: explicitly authorized domains only; passive queries only

tools.integration: Entity, sanctions and PEP screening with source attribution and licensing controls.
tools.cost_model: API uses prepaid credits for screening; non-commercial bulk data is free; defer hosted API and assess local dataset licensing before use

tools.integration: Local extension-only cookie metadata inspection for the active tab. Never reads or displays cookie values and never sends cookie data to MindCloud.
tools.security: user-initiated, active tab only, metadata only, no value collection or network transfer

tools.integration: Open-source React UI components and page blocks; candidate for MindCloud interface redesign and reusable production components. Use copied components only after license and dependency checks.
tools.license: MIT (verify repository license at integration time)
tools.evidence_status: official project page located; repository/API integration not yet verified

tools.integration: Potential AI-assisted design workflow across Watermelon ecosystem. The official site describes Watermelon AI as in development; keep as research-only until a usable API or integration surface is documented.
tools.evidence_status: official site describes the product as in development; no executable endpoint verified

tools.integration: Candidate delegated research and multi-step task execution provider. Official API supports task, project, file, webhook, skill and agent workflows; implement only through a supervised adapter with typed inputs, evidence capture, quotas and explicit approval for consequential actions.
tools.security: external task execution; scope inputs, restrict secrets, audit outputs and require approval before external writes
tools.evidence_status: official API documentation located; MindCloud adapter not implemented or live-tested

tools.integration: Candidate mobile app for saving places discovered on TikTok and Instagram to a personal map and guides. Potential workflow overlap with MindCloud Point Registry, but no public API or supported integration was verified; keep as discovery-only.
tools.authentication: app account; API availability not verified
tools.evidence_status: App Store listing located; no public API or export contract verified

tools.integration: Optional read-only MCP discovery bridge. MindCloud can inspect the RuFlo tool catalog when explicitly enabled; invoking discovered tools is deliberately not supported.
tools.cost_model: open-source; runtime package fetched by npm when explicitly enabled
tools.authentication: local process; inherits only a minimal environment allowlist
tools.security: disabled by default; read-only initialize/tools/list; no tool invocation, no arbitrary command input; process timeout and bounded output
tools.evidence_status: official MCP handshake and tools/list verified in GitHub Actions; production adapter not yet enabled or live-tested

tools.integration: Research candidate for local speech transcription and word-silhouette visualization. Documentation reviewed; no executable MindCloud adapter or runtime verification is claimed.
tools.cost_model: no paid service required by the documented local engine; license clearance required before commercial use
tools.license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use requires permission from the author
tools.security: microphone explicit opt-in; camera optional; transcript forwarding off by default; verify network egress and cleanup before promotion
